title: Reconciliation observation record (one canonical-JSON line per scanned instance)
description: Machine-readable contract for governance/state/observations/repo=<repo>/date=YYYY-MM-DD/run-<run_id>.jsonl. An observation is the scanner's derived output: manifest unit-attrs joined with marker instance-attrs joined with computed hashes joined with drift joined with run provenance, emitted per scan (baseline §4.1/§4.4). This schema is the SOLE output contract the P3 canonical-drift-scanner follows (#8). The region/hash fields are derived from the managed-region marker whose final form is fixed in governance/schema/field-ownership.md (baseline §4.8 #13). Hash policy: normalized hash is the gate, raw hash is forensic-only (baseline §4.5). Whole-tool units (psa.py, the scanner) carry no markers and no hashes, so the region/hash fields are null and drift is 'n/a' (the whole-tool null convention, baseline §4.4).

schema_version.description: Observation record-shape era; lets the observation tier evolve columns independently under schema-on-read (baseline §4.8 #16).

run_id.description: Scan run identity, UTC basic ISO-8601 (baseline §4.8 #14).

runtime.description: Run provenance; the runtime is stamped, not pinned (baseline §3/§4.4).

duckdb.description: Resolved DuckDB version, stamped per run. DuckDB is introduced only at P8 (ADR 0002); a scanner that does not use DuckDB stamps "n/a" (ADR 0016 F1).

commit.description: Git SHA of the scanned commit.

unit_id.description: Foreign key to the manifest unit (baseline §4.4). The consumers list lives only in the manifest; this record never re-lists consumers.

granularity.description: The two granularities (baseline §3). whole-tool carries no markers/hashes; region is a marked, hashed, compared region. Derived from kind, not a manifest field (ADR 0016 F3): powershell-helper/bash-region/spec-region -> region; python-helper/python-tool/tool -> whole-tool; governance-doc is out of this scanner's body-hash-drift scope (ADR 0014).

consumer.description: The consumer (or tool) whose file holds this instance.

region_locator.description: Provenance for a region: marker id / BEGIN-END / line span. Null for whole-tool (baseline §4.4).

canonical_version.description: Version/tag the marker claims synced. Null for whole-tool.

canonical_hash_norm.description: Normalized hash of the canonical region at the recorded version — the gate input (baseline §4.5). Null for whole-tool.

observed_hash_norm.description: Normalized hash of the observed inlined region — the gate input (baseline §4.5). Null for whole-tool.

observed_hash_raw.description: Verbatim byte hash of the observed region — forensic only, not used by the gate (baseline §4.5). Null for whole-tool.

hash_what.description: What was hashed and how it was normalized. Null for whole-tool.

drift.description: Fast-filter drift state. 'n/a' is reserved for whole-tool; 'forked-frozen' for forked regions (frozen, not compared); match/drift for compared regions; 'unknown' is the determinability fallback for a region the scanner located but could not resolve to a comparison result (ADR 0016 F4; precise conditions pinned at P6) (baseline §4.4/§4.5).

forwarded.description: DEP-3 fork field (baseline §2.3): not-needed | pending | done | rejected, or a forwarding ref. Populated on forked regions.

applied_upstream.description: DEP-3 fork field (baseline §2.3): version/commit where the change was accepted upstream.

change_reason.description: DEP-3 fork field (baseline §2.3): free-text reason for a fork.

reason_class.description: DEP-3 fork field (baseline §2.3): reason class for a fork.

ext.description: Open extension object for ad-hoc analysis fields, kept out of the top-level namespace so old and new records stay queryable together (schema-on-read; baseline §4.4).

allOf.description: Whole-tool null convention: whole-tool units carry no markers/hashes; region & hash fields are null and drift is 'n/a' (baseline §4.4).
Region granularity: a marked, hashed, compared region requires non-null region & hash fields, and drift is a compared state (not 'n/a').
